expectations.text: Guides user to specific reference platforms (Mobbin, Dribbble, competitors)
expectations.evidence: Provides platform-specific search queries for Mobbin (pet care, marketplace), Dribbble (pet app UI), and names 5 competitor apps to study

expectations.text: Organizes references by category (pet apps, marketplace patterns, booking flows)
expectations.evidence: Creates 4-category framework: pet-specific apps, general marketplace UX, booking/scheduling flows, and trust/review patterns

expectations.text: Identifies common visual patterns relevant to pet care marketplace
expectations.evidence: Identifies patterns: pet profile cards with photo prominence, trust badges, service provider ratings, warm color palettes, friendly typography

expectations.text: Produces a structured design references deliverable or moodboard framework
expectations.evidence: Outputs a design-references.md deliverable with categorized links, pattern notes, and visual direction summary

expectations.text: Establishes visual vocabulary that prevents blank-canvas paralysis
expectations.evidence: Concludes with visual vocabulary: color direction, typography style, layout patterns, and interaction paradigms to carry into Figma
